cards.title: Branches are parallel versions
cards.body: A branch lets you try something without touching `main`. `git branch` lists branches; the one with `*` is where you are.
cards.code:
git init
touch a.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git branch idea
git branch

hi.title: Branches parallel versions hain
hi.body: Branch se aap `main` ko chhue bina kuch try kar sakte ho. `git branch` branches ki list dikhata hai; `*` wali woh hai jahan aap ho.

cards.title: Switching
cards.body: `git switch <name>` moves you to a branch. `git switch -c <name>` creates one and moves you there in one step.
cards.code:
git init
touch a.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch -c idea
git branch

hi.title: Switch karna
hi.body: `git switch <name>` aapko ek branch par le jaata hai. `git switch -c <name>` ek hi step mein branch banata hai aur aapko wahan le jaata hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The last command fails: there is no branch to move to. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
git init
touch a.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch idea

bug.fix: `git switch` only moves to a branch that exists. `git switch -c idea` creates it and moves you there.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Aakhri command fail hoti hai: jaane ke liye koi branch nahi hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `git switch` sirf maujood branch par le jaata hai. `git switch -c idea` use banata hai aur aapko wahan le jaata hai.

check.question: Which command creates a branch called `dark-mode` and switches to it?
check.explanation: `-c` means create. `git branch -d` would delete a branch instead.

hi.question: Kaunsi command `dark-mode` naam ki branch banati hai aur us par switch karti hai?
hi.explanation: `-c` ka matlab create. `git branch -d` ulta branch delete kar deta.

exercise.prompt: Create a branch called `dark-mode` and switch to it.
exercise.promptHi: `dark-mode` naam ki branch banao aur us par switch karo.
